name: Delegates Verification
description: An authenticator hands verification to another service: the Duo authenticator redirects the user to Duo's prompt, an external-IdP authenticator to that IdP. The target is OPEN (omitted): the verifier is another plugin's node (duo's duo__duo_account today), and this plugin does not depend on it.

api_hostname.description: The verifier's API host (for Duo, api-XXXXXXXX.duosecurity.com or a Duo Federal host).
